=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3709-3725 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A traceback with more than 400 lines (`_TRACEBACK_SCAN_MAX_LINES`) before its exception line ends the scan at `scan_end` with `exception_seen` still False, so the exception line is dropped from the kept set.
  WHY: The heal evidence loses the exception line for very deep tracebacks. Severity disagreement: google_gemini rated MAJOR, the others NIT; the highest is used. The sonnet reviewer calls it a documented, bounded limitation.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3712 | severity=major | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The scan loop breaks on any line matching `_TRACEBACK_HEADER_RE`, even one inside a traceback frame or source line.
  WHY: Such a line would end the scan early and lose the remaining frames and the exception line. Sonnet, minimax and glm rejected this, because a real frame does not contain the literal header text.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3746 | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_traceback_context_indices(lines)` adds an extra O(n) pass over `lines` before the main keep loop in `filter_log`.
  WHY: Every heal log is now scanned twice; the cost is bounded and small, and the reviewer logged it only as a measurement.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (check-runs `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, `orchestrate-poll (2)`, aggregate `lint`) | severity=nit | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Three check-runs failed on the PR head, and neither reviewer could map the failures to the diff.
  WHY: The aggregate `lint` gate blocks merge even though the failures appear inherited or unrelated.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A chained traceback's header starts its own block."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, _traceback_context_indices
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The scan loop breaks on the header at line 3712 before processing it, so the header is not included in the block or kept set. Sonnet, minimax and glm refuted this, because `\bTraceback\b` in `_SOFT_LOG_PATTERNS` keeps the header and `index = cursor` starts a new block.
- requirement: Tests for `test_filter_log_keeps_the_innermost_lines_of_a_long_traceback` (PR description "Testing" section); coverage of the 400-line scan cap
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py, test_filter_log_keeps_the_innermost_lines_of_a_long_traceback
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The new test exercises only an 82-line traceback. Nothing covers `_TRACEBACK_SCAN_MAX_LINES = 400` or the early exit at `while cursor < scan_end:` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3710).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py: `scan_end = min(total, cursor + _TRACEBACK_SCAN_MAX_LINES)` and the inner `while cursor < scan_end` loop in `_traceback_context_indices` | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: A traceback with more than 400 indented or blank lines after its header ends at `scan_end` with `exception_seen` still False. Only its last 30 scanned lines are kept, and the exception line is never reached.
  WHY: This needs a traceback of more than 400 lines. The scan cap is intentional and documented in the changelog and the `agents.d` fragment, so this is a bounded, documented limitation.
- CI check-run failures (`lint`, `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, `orchestrate-poll (2)`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The reviewer could not map these failures to the diff.
  WHY: `lint` is an aggregate that fails only because the other two jobs failed. The diff touches only `filter_log` and its tests, and the editor should check that no test in those jobs depends on the exact output of `filter_log`.
- Hardening suggestion (not raised as a finding): scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, `content = _LOG_TIMESTAMP_RE.sub("", lines[cursor])` in `_traceback_context_indices` | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: Streams prefixed with `  | ` look indented on every line, so `exception_seen` is never set. The reviewer did not verify the lines cited from pass 1 (`scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh` lines 4734 and 4766, `scripts/summarize_reviewer_consensus.sh` line 510).
  WHY: The shape is speculative for the logs that reach `filter_log`. If reviewer streams do reach this path, strip the `  | ` prefix before classifying (about 2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3712 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The scan loop breaks if a log line matches _TRACEBACK_HEADER_RE, even if that line is part of a traceback frame or source code.
  WHY: If a line inside the traceback contains the text "Traceback (most recent call last)", the scan terminates early and misses the remaining frames and the exception line.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3710 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The scan loop is bounded by _TRACEBACK_SCAN_MAX_LINES (400 lines).
  WHY: If the exception line is outside this window, exception_seen remains False and the exception line is not kept, so the heal evidence is inconclusive for very deep stack traces.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "A chained traceback's header starts its own block." | Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, _traceback_context_indices | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Evidence of absence: The scan loop breaks on the header at line 3712 before processing it, so the header is not included in the block or kept set.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3710-3721 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a traceback has more than 400 lines between its header and its exception line, the inner `while cursor < scan_end:` loop exits with `exception_seen == False` and no exception line in `block`, and nothing scans beyond `scan_end`.
  WHY: `kept.update(block[-_TRACEBACK_CONTEXT_MAX_LINES:])` then holds only some frames. The exception line is missing from the heal evidence, so the heal is inconclusive again for that case.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3746 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_traceback_context_indices(lines)` adds one extra O(n) pass over `lines` before the main keep loop.
  WHY: Every heal log is now scanned twice. The cost is bounded and small in practice, and the reviewer logged it only as a measurement.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Tests: `test_filter_log_keeps_chained_traceback_frames_and_exception_lines_outside_tail` and `test_filter_log_keeps_the_innermost_lines_of_a_long_traceback`" | Expected change site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py, test_filter_log_keeps_the_innermost_lines_of_a_long_traceback | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Evidence of absence: The new test exercises only an 82-line traceback. No test covers a traceback whose exception line sits past the 400-line scan window, so `_TRACEBACK_SCAN_MAX_LINES` and the early exit at scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3710 are untested.
- Hardening suggestion: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, `_traceback_context_indices`, after line 3721 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
  PROBLEM: When `cursor == scan_end` and `exception_seen is False`, the function returns without the exception line.
  WHY: Suggested fix: forward-scan from `scan_end` for the first non-indented, non-header, non-chain line and append it (about 6 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3709-3725 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a traceback has more than `_TRACEBACK_SCAN_MAX_LINES` (400) lines before its exception line, such as a RecursionError, the inner scan loop is cut by the window, so the exception line is never appended to the block.
  WHY: The kept 30 lines are frames near line 400, and the exception line matches neither `_SOFT_LOG_PATTERNS` nor the tail window in `filter_log` (line 3748), so it is dropped from heal evidence.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml (check-runs on PR head 6f1ff597c28b; failing jobs `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, `orchestrate-poll (2)`, aggregate `lint`) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Three check-runs failed on the PR head, but neither failure maps to the diff.
  WHY: The aggregate `lint` gate blocks merge regardless of this change until the unrelated jobs are fixed or triaged.
- Hardening suggestion: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, `_traceback_context_indices`, after line 3721 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
  PROBLEM: A traceback longer than the 400-line scan window loses its exception line entirely.
  WHY: Suggested fix: on window exhaustion, forward-scan from `scan_end` for the first unindented, non-header, non-chain line and append it before the last-30 cut (~6 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
